originalTitle: Global Markets (SPGM) or Emerging Growth (IEMG)? Which Fund is the Right Choice?
summary: Both funds charge identical 0.09% fees, but IEMG delivered 29.7% trailing returns versus SPGM's 20.8%, though with steeper volatility and drawdowns.
